//: Every field is optional and every command-line flag has a twin here — see DedicatedConfig in server/dedicated.ts for what each one means. Flags win over the file, and the shortest useful config is an empty object.
//seed: OMIT to roll a fresh seed, which is printed. A literal replays the same run on every restart, which is what a bug report wants and a public server does not.
//bots: Seats filled with AUTOPILOT heroes, 1-8; omit for none. Below 8 they join after the first human and yield their seats to later arrivals; 8 starts an autonomous run immediately. A value outside 1-8 is refused at startup.
//mods: Mod ids in load order. A joiner whose list differs is refused by name. Config-only — there is no --mods flag on this server.
//licensed: THE OPERATOR'S LICENCE DECLARATION (--licensed). Without it the server starts, binds, prints its address and refuses every join. It is a declaration, not a check; a store build carries the same word in its packaging.
//allowUnlicensedTransport: The repo's OWN escape, for its suites and the headless soak fleet — config-only, no flag. In a packaged binary it does nothing at all: the ship target folds UNLICENSED_TRANSPORT_UNLOCKED (server/licence.ts) to false.
//noPortMap: Never ask the router to forward the bound port (--no-portmap). Leave false on a home connection; set it true on a box whose ports are already forwarded.
